async function cached(items, load) {
	let value = null;
	while (true) {
		for (const item of items) {
			value ??= await load(item);
		}
	}
}
async function reset(items, load) {
	let value = null;
	while (true) {
		for (const item of items) {
			value = null;
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			value ??= await load(item);
		}
	}
}
